dfr.feature.name: CPU flaws and recalls
dfr.feature.desc: Hidden flaws in released CPUs: recall, new stepping, patch or ignore
dfr.param.aiFlaws.label: Flaws for rivals (AI)
dfr.param.aiFlaws.tooltip: AI companies also release CPUs with hidden flaws and decide for themselves how to respond.
dfr.param.showRiskHint.label: Risk hint in the designer
dfr.param.showRiskHint.tooltip: Shows the estimated chance of a hidden flaw while you design a CPU.
dfr.param.rushEnabled.label: Rush projects
dfr.param.rushEnabled.tooltip: The designer gets a "Rush project" switch: a shorter term and a higher cost, but a higher chance of a hidden flaw too.
dfr.param.flawFrequency.label: Flaw frequency
dfr.param.flawFrequency.tooltip: A multiplier of the chance of a hidden flaw: 0.5 is half as often, 2.0 is twice as often.
dfr.param.debug.label: Debug
dfr.param.debug.tooltip: Shows the button that forces a flaw on the "Flaws and recalls" page, for testing (debug build only).
dfr.event.public.title: Flaw in {1}: {2}
dfr.event.public.body: The press reports a defect ({3}). Affected units: {4}. OEM clients await your response.
dfr.event.public.cause: A recall costs now but restores trust. A patch is cheap but cuts performance. Ignoring hurts clients and reputation.
dfr.event.public.nopatch.cause: There is no patch for this defect yet. A recall costs now but restores trust. A new stepping is cheaper, but the flaw stays known while it is made. Ignoring hurts clients and reputation.
dfr.event.internal.title: Engineers found a defect in {1}
dfr.event.internal.body: The public does not know yet ({2}, {3}). Affected units: {4}. A quiet fix is cheaper, but a leak will hurt more.
dfr.event.internal.cause: A quiet stepping and a patch cost no noise, but the defect may leak: then the blow to reputation is twice as hard. A recall makes the problem public at once.
dfr.event.internal.nopatch.cause: There is no patch for this defect yet. A quiet stepping costs no noise, but the defect may leak: then the blow to reputation is twice as hard. A recall makes the problem public at once.
dfr.event.leaked.title: Leak: the hidden defect in {1} is public
dfr.event.leaked.body: The defect ({2}, {3}) could not be kept hidden. Affected units: {4}. Ignoring the problem is no longer possible.
dfr.event.leaked.cause: Reputation has already suffered twice as much as usual. A recall costs a lot, a new stepping is cheaper, a patch cuts performance.
dfr.event.leaked.nopatch.cause: Reputation has already suffered twice as much as usual. There is no patch for this defect: choose a recall or a new stepping.
dfr.fx.ignore: Risk: OEM loss {0}%, lawsuit up to {1}
dfr.mail.auto.title: Automatic decision on flaw {0}
dfr.mail.auto.body: The event engine is unavailable; the default response was applied: {1}. Cost: {2}.
dfr.news.title: {0}: flaw in {1}
dfr.news.leaked.title: {0}: hidden flaw in {1} leaked
dfr.news.leaked.body: The cover-up failed: the defect in {1} ({2}, {3}) is public. {0} {4}.
dfr.news.rival.title: {0}: defect in {1}
dfr.news.reaction.patch: is releasing a patch that costs some performance
dfr.log.auto: Decision made automatically: time ran out
dfr.journal.title: Flaws and recalls
dfr.journal.unavailable: The page is unavailable: the list could not be created.
dfr.journal.error: The list could not be shown (see the mod log).
dfr.journal.empty.mine: None of your CPUs has a known flaw.
dfr.journal.status.waitingInternal: Only you know, awaiting a decision
dfr.journal.status.resolvedPatch: Closed: the patch term is over
dfr.journal.status.expired: Moot: the CPU left the market
dfr.journal.fundStepping.tip: A new stepping fixes the flaw for good. The patch stays until it is done.
dfr.journal.fund.confirm.title: New stepping instead of a patch
dfr.journal.fund.confirm.body: Fund a new stepping for {0}? Cost: {1}, term: {2} days. The patch stays until the stepping is done.
dfr.journal.fund.failed: The stepping could not be started: {0}
dfr.journal.debug.heading: Debug: force a flaw
dfr.hint.title: Hidden flaw risk
dfr.hint.tip: The chance that the CPU gets a hidden flaw when it is released. It grows with overclocking, heat, an immature process and rushing.
dfr.rush.tooltip: Time −{0}%, cost +{1}%, higher risk of a hidden flaw
